exemptions.title: Commodity meant for export
exemptions.description: Pre-packaged commodities meant for export are exempt from domestic labeling requirements.

exemptions.title: Commodity for institutional supply
exemptions.description: Pre-packaged commodities supplied to hotels, restaurants, or institutions for bulk use may have simplified labeling.

exemptions.title: Commodity with net quantity less than prescribed minimum
exemptions.description: Small packages with very low net quantity may have relaxed font size requirements.

exemptions.title: Non-retail packages
exemptions.description: Packages not intended for retail sale are exempt from certain labeling requirements.

exemptions.title: Gift packages
exemptions.description: Complimentary gift packages may have simplified labeling.

exemptions.title: Medicines and drugs
exemptions.description: Products regulated under Drugs and Cosmetics Act may have separate labeling requirements.

exemptions.title: Agricultural produce
exemptions.description: Certain agricultural produce in original form may have simplified requirements.
